يتعرقبان (form IIq)
# يَتَعَرْقَبَانِ (yataʕarqabāni) /ja.ta.ʕar.qa.baː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# يُتَعَرْقَبَانِ (yutaʕarqabāni) /ju.ta.ʕar.qa.baː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
